tvShow.name: Stick
tvShow.overview: Pryce Cahill was headed for golf greatness when an on-course meltdown derailed his career. Now struggling to stay afloat, he goes all in to mentor Santi—a teenage phenom with immense potential—and maybe save himself.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: Pryce is down on his luck when a chance encounter at the driving range sends him on a mission to secure the opportunity of a lifetime.

episodes.name: Grossweiner's Law
episodes.overview: Mitts and Pryce evaluate Santi's game over 18 holes. While testing out new clubs, Pryce tries to impart some wisdom about staying in the moment.

episodes.name: Daddy Issues
episodes.overview: The gang hits the road in Mitts' RV. Pryce's coaching methods get tested in their first tourney. Santi makes a friend who unlocks his game.

episodes.name: Zero Sum Game
episodes.overview: Pryce does everything he can to break through to Santi and get back to training. Zero is presented with an unexpected offer.

episodes.name: The Birdie Machine
episodes.overview: Santi tees off at the qualifier with a new caddy as Pryce deploys covert coaching tactics. Mitts delivers harsh truths—and gets some right back.

episodes.name: RV Shangri-La
episodes.overview: Ahead of the U.S. Amateur Championship, Pryce gives everyone a rest day on the campgrounds. Mitts takes a risk. Santi makes a painful discovery.

episodes.name: Dreams Never Remembered
episodes.overview: After a blowup with Santi, Pryce is lost in thought about his past and what could've been. The gang prepare to go their separate ways.

episodes.name: Clark the Mark
episodes.overview: A brazen plan is hatched to hustle Clark Ross. Pryce gets a chance to prove he was always the better golfer.

episodes.name: Showtime
episodes.overview: Pryce tries to help Santi deal with the pressure of his first PGA tournament. Romantic sparks fly as Santi starts climbing the leaderboard.

episodes.name: Déjà Vu All Over Again
episodes.overview: On the last day of the tournament, an unexpected visitor shakes things up while Santi's golf dreams hang in the balance.
